name: ai-code-review-agent
description: AI Code Review Agent — Claude tool-use agent (api) + React trace/review UI (react)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,react -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix react"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix react
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix api && npm run test --prefix react
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix react
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm install --prefix api --include=dev && npm run build --prefix api && npm install --prefix react --include=dev && VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build --prefix react
